text: You welcomed guests and shared your food, just like Hadhrat Ibrahim (as).
You stayed patient when you were ill, like Hadhrat Ayyub (as).
You forgave your brother, just as Hadhrat Yusuf (as) forgave his brothers.
Someone was unkind to you, and you prayed for them, like the Holy Prophet (sa) did in Ta'if.
You kept your promise, even though it was hard. People call you trustworthy — like Al-Amin!
You said Bismillah before eating and Alhamdulillah after.
You helped your parents without being asked, like Hadhrat Yahya (as), who was kind to his parents.
You thanked Allah for a small blessing today.
You never gave up calling people to good, like Hadhrat Nuh (as).
You were fair in sharing the sweets, like Hadhrat Shu'ayb (as) taught about fair weighing.
You said sorry quickly when you made a mistake, like Hadhrat Adam (as) did.
You learned a new du'a by heart.
You helped carry the bricks to build the mosque, like the companions at Masjid Quba.
Your caravan reaches {landmark} — what a blessed journey!
You set off early on your journey and arrive at {landmark}.
You told the truth even when it was difficult.
You gave water to a thirsty animal. Kindness to animals is rewarded!
You visited a friend who was sick.
You trusted Allah when you were worried, like the mother of Hadhrat Musa (as).
You read a story of the prophets to your little brother or sister.
You smiled at everyone you met. A smile is a charity!
You prayed on time, even though you were busy playing.
You gave away a toy you loved to someone who had none.
You were brave and stood up for what is right, like Hadhrat Ibrahim (as) in front of the idol-worshippers.
You kept your room tidy without being asked. Cleanliness is half of faith!
You made peace between two friends who were arguing.
You shared your umbrella in the rain.
You remembered Allah all day, like Hadhrat Zakariyya (as) did in his prayers.
You told a fib. The Holy Prophet (sa) was called Al-Amin — the trustworthy.
You gave up too quickly. Hadhrat Nuh (as) never gave up!
You got angry and walked away, like Hadhrat Yunus (as) left too soon. Come back and say sorry.
You wasted water when making wudu.
You forgot to say Bismillah before eating.
You were rude to a guest. Hadhrat Ibrahim (as) always honoured his guests.
You made fun of someone. Every person is precious to Allah.
You took more than your fair share of the sweets. Hadhrat Shu'ayb (as) taught fair weighing!
You were late for prayer because of a video game. Back to {landmark}!
You complained instead of being patient. Remember Hadhrat Ayyub (as)!
You forgot your promise to help. Go back and keep it!
You left litter in the park.
You argued with your brother over the last piece of cake.
You were jealous of your friend's new bike, like the brothers of Hadhrat Yusuf (as) were jealous.
Your caravan took the wrong road through the desert. Back to {landmark}.
You talked during the Friday sermon.
You didn't listen to your parents.
You overslept and missed Fajr prayer.
You boasted about how good you are. Humble people are loved by Allah.
You were unkind to an animal. The Holy Prophet (sa) taught kindness to every creature.
You lost your way in the desert because you didn't follow the guide. Back to {landmark}!
You took something without asking.
You ate too many dates at Iftar and got a tummy ache!
A sandstorm! The whole caravan has to wait.
You said something unkind behind a friend's back.
You rushed your prayer to get back to playing.
Your camel wandered off while you were napping. Back to {landmark}!
You forgot to thank the person who helped you.
